items.q: Then another big work I probably should mention is a work commissioned by the New York Philharmonic for Dexter Gordon.

ctx.x: Jazz band. Then another big work I probably should mention is a work commissioned by the New York Philharmonic for Dexter Gordon. It’s called Ellingtones, recorded by the Tokyo Philharmonic for Blue Note Records. [It has] never been released, but it was of singular importance, simply because it was the last work that Dexter Gordon recorded.
